caption: The drawing features three objects arranged vertically on a plain, light beige background. At the top and bottom of the composition, there are two similar rectangular bands, each shaded in brown and gold tones with a carved or engraved pattern visible on their surfaces. In the center, there is a circular ring in shades of gold and brown, shown from a slightly angled perspective with its band thick and adorned with symmetry; it has additional raised elements on either side that may represent details of its design. All the objects are centered within a lightly drawn rectangular border, and the bottom right corner of the drawing contains the handwritten name "Bertha Semple." The overall composition is simple and symmetrical, focusing on the depiction of these jewelry-like items.
title: Wedding Ring
